skills.description: Pre-development gatekeeper against impulsive "vibe coding". Auto-invoked when the user signals intent to build/develop/code something new — especially when under-specified, solution-first, or whimsical ("帮我做个应用", "我想开发…", jumps to framework before stating the problem) — and on explicit demand ("用 anti-vibecoding 审一下", "grill me"). Two modes: (1) Quick Check — a multiple-choice self-assessment (5 dimensions x 3 questions) for a lightweight "pause and think", yielding an impulse index + developer persona; (2) Deep Dialogue — an adversarial five-gate "grill me" interview (motivation / market / capability / use-case / solution) that concludes by offering existing open-source tools and a preliminary PRD for secondary development. Forbids coding until gates pass. Do not use for pure research/Q&A, editing files the user already owns, or documentation/analysis deliverables.

skills.description_zh:
把啰嗦的 prompt 压成精简高效版，少打字少烧 token。

skills.description: 给任意 skill 注入"条件化案例推理(CBR)案例库"——先按芒格条件做 fit-check 判定目标 skill 是否值得建库，通过后再参数化检索键、脚手架 cases/ 目录、并把"检索复用"接入规划阶段、"自动沉淀"接入交付阶段。
skills.description_zh:
条件化 CBR 案例库脚手架——把一个"会越用越聪明"的案例推理(Case-Based Reasoning)库，按统一方法注入任意 skill。

核心纪律（来自认知放大器结论 + 芒格条件观）：
1. **不是所有 skill 都该有案例库**。先用 fit-check（芒格条件门）判定：目标 skill 是否含"可复用的判断/手艺(tradecraft) under uncertainty"、经验积累能否提升产出。
纯确定性 / 单路径 / 纯格式转换的 skill 建库 = 噪声 + 维护负担，直接拒绝。
2. **建库方法要有条件、要抽象**：检索键必须参数化（按领域定义受控词表），案例必须抽象成方法模板(tradecraft)而非叙事堆砌，
成功案例配对失败案例对抗锚定，维护周期对齐工具半衰期。
3. **flow 标准**：构建后必须实际验证（读回产物确认合法），置信度由验证反推，禁止纯 AI 自评。
